director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?

Aaj hum kisi shape ke chaaron taraf ka poora kinaara naapenge. Cricket ki pitch socho, lagbhag 20 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Ek kone se chalo, kinaare-kinaare pitch ghoomkar wahin lauto. Jitna chale, utna pitch ka parimap hai. Yahi chakkar ab ek triangle par. Ab tak samajh aaya?

Koi baat nahi, ise aur aasaan karke samjhaati hoon. Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain, 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone par ungli rakho aur kinaare par chalao: pehli bhuja, doosri, teesri, aur wapas usi kone par. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

seams.form: Koi baat nahi, ise aur aasaan karke samjhaati hoon.

director.text: Board ki line dekho: ungli ka poora safar wahi hai. Us line ki har bhuja ki lambai milakar socho. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain; iska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: Bilkul, ise doosre, aasaan shabdon mein bolti hoon. Socho is triangle ka kinaara ek dhaage se bana hai. Ek kone se dhaaga khol ke seedha kar do: 4 cm, phir 5 cm, phir 6 cm, sab ek line mein. Us seedhi line ki poori lambai hi parimap hai. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain; iska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

seams.form: Bilkul, ise doosre, aasaan shabdon mein bolti hoon.

director.text: Sahi jawab, kyunki 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti. Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare mein aati hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Hexagon ki kitni bhujaon par label likha hai?
Label sirf ek bhuja par likha hai. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai: chhah bhujayein, har ek 5 cm ki: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: pehle 6, phir bagal ki bhuja 4, phir 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Dhaaga kahan chalta hai, kinaare par ya andar?
Dhaaga kinaare par chalta hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: Rectangle ka kinaara ek dhaage ki tarah khul gaya hai: 6 cm, 4 cm, 6 cm, 4 cm. Andar ki jagah is line mein nahi aati. 6 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude rectangle ke kinaare par ek baar lapetne mein kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: 24 cm sahi nahi hai. Aao, isko ek naye dhang se dekhein. Socho, ek rectangle ke kinaare par dhaaga lapeta, phir khol ke scale par rakha: woh lambai parimap hai, centimetre mein. Andar tiles bichhao toh woh area hai. Parimap mein chaaron bhujayein jodte hain, guna nahi. Yahan tak theek hai?

seams.form: Aao, isko ek naye dhang se dekhein.

director.text: Is rectangle ko ek chhota aangan socho: deewar kinaare par chalti hai, aur andar farsh hai jo area hai. Deewar ki lambai ke liye bhujayein jodte hain; lambai aur chaudai ka guna sirf farsh batata hai. Tumhare paas 140 cm ribbon hai. 14 cm lambe, 9 cm chaude sticker ke kinaare-kinaare ribbon lagao. Kitna bachega?
director.card: Tumhare paas 140 cm ribbon hai. 14 cm lambe, 9 cm chaude sticker ke kinaare-kinaare ribbon lagao. Kitna bachega?

director.text: Ribbon andar nahi jaata. Pehle dekho kinaare par kitna lagega, phir use 140 mein se ghatao. 140 cm ribbon mein se 14 cm lambe, 9 cm chaude sticker ke kinaare-kinaare ek baar lagaane ke baad kitna ribbon bachega?
director.card: Tumhare paas 140 cm ribbon hai. 14 cm lambe, 9 cm chaude sticker ke kinaare-kinaare ribbon lagao. Kitna bachega?

director.text: Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 94 cm hai, kyunki kinaare par 14 + 9 + 14 + 9 = 46 cm lagega, toh 140 − 46 = 94 cm bachega. Yahan tak saaf hai?
14 do baar 28 aur 9 do baar 18, toh kinaare par 46 cm; 140 mein se pehle 40 hatao toh 100, phir 6 aur hatao toh 94 cm. Ab tak samajh aaya?
Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

seams.form: Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: 24 cm nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Ek kone se dhaaga lapetna shuru karo aur wapas usi kone tak aao; har bhuja par jitna dhaaga khula, woh jodte jao. 6 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude rectangle ke kinaare par ek baar lapetne mein kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: Sahi jawab, kyunki dhaaga sirf kinaare par chalta hai: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 cm. Kadam-kadam karke, agla sawaal milkar hal karein?
director.workedInvite: Kadam-kadam karke, agla sawaal milkar hal karein?

director.text: Ulta socho: 6 × 4 = 24 toh andar ke chhote square hote, dhaaga nahi; dhaage ke liye 6 do baar aur 4 do baar, yaani 12 aur 8, kul 20 cm. Yeh hissa saaf hua?

Is rectangle ko ek photo frame socho. Frame ki lakdi sirf kinaare par hoti hai, 6, 4, 6 aur 4; beech mein photo hoti hai. Lakdi ki poori lambai parimap hai, aur photo ki jagah area. Yahan tak saaf hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
Achha, toh tumhe chauka sabse achha lagta hai. Yahan tak theek hai?

j2.line: Achha, toh tumhe chauka sabse achha lagta hai.

director.text: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Phoolon ki ek kyari triangle jaisi hai, bhujayein 7 m, 9 m aur 12 m. Uske kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Dekhte hain, kitni lambi baad lagegi. Baad kinaare par lagegi, toh teeno bhujayein jodni hain: P = 7 + 9 + 12, kyunki ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh baad mein wahan khaali jagah reh jaayegi. Pehle 7 aur 9 jodo: kitne metre hue?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: Pehle 7 aur 9 jodo: 7 + 9 = 16 m, kyunki do bhujayein ho gayi, teesri abhi baaki hai. Teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?
director.card: Teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?

director.text: Sahi jawab. Dekho, baad ko teeno bhujaon par chalna hai, ek bhi bhuja chhoot nahi sakti. Toh poora jawab: kyari ke liye 28 m lambi baad. Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain. Ek kone se ghoomo toh: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Usi kone par wapas pahunchne tak kitne metre chaloge?
director.card: Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain. Ek kone se ghoomo toh: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Usi kone par wapas pahunchne tak kitne metre chaloge?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai: chaaron bhujayein judti hain: 9 + 6 + 7 + 4 = 26 m. Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?
director.card: Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

director.text: 40 cm sahi nahi hai. Board par card ki chaaron bhujayein dekho, chahe number sirf do par likha ho. Socho, guna ki jagah inke saath kya karna hai. 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?
director.card: Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

director.text: Bilkul sahi, kyunki parimap kinaara hai: 10 + 4 + 10 + 4 = 28 cm; 10 × 4 andar ki jagah hai. Seedhi bhujaon wali har shape mein har bhuja jodna chalta hai. Ab ek rectangle socho: iski bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, aur isse jodne ka ek jaldi wala tareeka milta hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
Seedhi bhujaon wali shape mein saari bhujayein jodna chalta hai. Rectangle mein bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, isse kaam chhota ho jaata hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?

Yahi sabse seedha tareeka hai jo mere paas hai, koi baat nahi. Is rectangle ki do lambi bhujayein 10 m ki hain, woh lambai hai. Do chhoti bhujayein 6 m ki, woh chaudai. Aamne-saamne ki bhujayein barabar hoti hain. 10 aur 6 ek-ek baar likhe hain, par chakkar lagao toh dono do-do baar milte hain. Is rectangle mein 10 m ki kitni bhujayein hain?

seams.form: Yahi sabse seedha tareeka hai jo mere paas hai, koi baat nahi.

director.text: 10 m ki do bhujayein hain. Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?
director.card: Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

director.text: 16 m sahi nahi hai. Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Socho, ek cheenti khet ke kone se chalti hai aur metre ginti jaati hai. Pehle lambai chali, phir chaudai: ab woh saamne wale kone par hai, bas aadha chakkar. Lambai + chaudai yahin tak hai. Shuru wala kona abhi do bhujayein door hai. Yahan tak theek hai?

seams.form: Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: Ek dhaage se rectangle ka poora kinaara banao, phir dhaage ko beech se mod ke do barabar tukde karo. Ek tukde mein bas ek lambai aur ek chaudai aati hai; lambai + chaudai mude hue dhaage jitna hai, poore dhaage jitna nahi. Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Woh kul kitne metre chali?
director.card: Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Woh kul kitne metre chali?

director.text: 27 m nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Board par dekho, cheenti ka poora chakkar kin bhujaon se banta hai; phir unki lambai jodo. 19 m lambe, 8 m chaude khet ka chakkar poora karke cheenti shuru wale kone par lauti; woh kul kitne metre chali?
director.card: Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Woh kul kitne metre chali?

director.text: Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 54 m hai, kyunki do lambai aur do chaudai: 19 + 8 + 19 + 8 = 54 m. Yahan tak saaf hai?
Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. 10 m lambe, 6 m chaude is rectangle ka ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hai?
director.card: Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

seams.form: Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain.

director.text: Sahi jawab. Dekho, 10 aur 6 dono do-do baar aate hain: 10 + 6 + 10 + 6 = 32 m. Naya rectangle: 12 m lamba, 5 m chauda. Neeche baayein kone se chalo, 12 m aage, phir 5 m upar. Ab tum saamne wale kone par ho, yaani aadha chakkar. Baaki aadha bhi utna hi lamba hai. Isliye parimap = 2 × (lambai + chaudai). Aadhe chakkar mein lambai kitni baar aati hai?
Thakaan ho toh aaram karna bilkul theek hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain.
